description: Register a programmed shot button on a machine. A program cuts the shot off either by weight (program_type "volumetric", set target_volume_g) or by time (program_type "timed", set target_time_s). One machine can have a mix of both. A program_number the machine already has is overwritten with these settings; shots logged on it keep pointing at it.

program_type.description: Cutoff method: "volumetric" (weight) or "timed" (duration). Defaults to volumetric.

target_time_s.description: Target shot duration cutoff in seconds (required for timed programs)

target_volume_g.description: Target yield cutoff in grams (required for volumetric programs)

volume_source.description: Confidence in the stored cutoff value, for either type

name: register_program
title: Register a machine program
